title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0471
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0471
Improper Input Validation Vulnerability in VeloCloud Orchestrator
Original Issue Date:September 23, 2026
Severity Rating: HIGH
Software Affected
VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem 5.2.3.15 or earlier
VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem 6.1.3.7 or earlier
VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem 6.4.2.7 or earlier
VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem 7.0.0.2 or earlier
Overview
A vulnerability has been reported in VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) which could allow a remote attacker to gain unauthorized access and compromise of affected systems.
Target Audience:
Users of VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of unauthorized access and compromise of affected systems.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and managed data.
Description
VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem has a security issue due to improper authorization. A remote attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by accessing the VCO web interface.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access and compromise f affected systems.
Note: This vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild. Users are strongly advised to apply the latest patches immediately.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the vendor:
https://www.arista.com/en/support/advisories-notices/security-advisory/24765-security-advisory-0183
